description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order of Maximum Retail Price on Bottled Drinkig water, w.e.f. 28.09.2018
reasoning: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for bottled drinking water, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for manufacturers, traders, and distributors. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory matters and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
